instruction: Download the image from "https://huggingface.co/datasets/xlangai/ubuntu_osworld_file_cache/resolve/main/multi_apps/3c8f201a-009d-4bbe-8b65-a6f8b35bb57f/kingbird.jpeg" and use GIMP to compress it to under 500KB, then save it as "small_bird.jpeg" on the Desktop.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey("ctrl", "alt", "t"); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires downloading image and compressing to under 500KB. Using existing check_image_file_size metric from official GIMP metrics library. Similar to original task but with different threshold.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator only checks file size constraint (under 500KB) but does not verify image content or compression actually occurred
Agent could pass by saving any small file or different image under 500KB as 'small_bird.jpeg' without actually compressing the original
No verification that the file is actually an image or that content relates to the source image from the URL
Instruction requires: download specific image, compress it with GIMP, save with specific name - evaluator only verifies final file size
Missing semantic verification of image content similarity to source (e.g., structure_check_by_ssim comparison with downloaded original)
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Download the source image as reference using get_cloud_file getter
Add structure similarity check (check_structure_sim_resized or similar) to verify the compressed image content matches the original
This ensures the agent actually compressed the correct image, not just saved any small file
Alternative: Add image format validation to at least ensure saved file is a valid JPEG image
